sources.title: All You Need to Know About Training Image Retrieval Models
sources.snippet: Image retrieval is the task of finding images in a database that are most similar to a given query image. The performance of an image retrieval pipeline depends on many training-time factors, including the embedding model architecture, loss function, data sampler, mining function, learning rate(s), and batch size.
